scope: Frozen author source, trusted immutable hash-validated ParentMap, one native process per qualification. This is not arbitrary-pointer, hostile-host or OOM certification.

findings.evidence: nio_alloc(8192) result is not checked before fixed frame[16..48] slicing; mi_copy/mi_put errors are ignored. Allocation failure can reach invalid output-buffer operations rather than clean refusal.
findings.also: v91_retained_extract.zag lines21-23: nio_alloc(32768) and pm_words(1024) results are unchecked before frame copying and seen[id] indexing.
findings.action: Check exact allocated lengths and all frame operation statuses before slicing/indexing; unwind owned frame/map/seen handles on all returns.
findings.admission_effect: No grant path exists; clean OOM refusal is not established.

findings.evidence: Early error returns omit closing the successfully loaded map and/or freeing frame; oracle output write failure returns -7 before cleanup. ve_bpe early returns similarly leave frame/seen allocations. Hash and concatenation strings are not consistently freed.
findings.action: Use one cleanup path and preserve single ownership. Keep qualification tools as short-lived isolated processes pending repair.
findings.dynamic_evidence: Native oracle/extractor nonexistent-output-directory runs refuse; this confirms failure status, not absence of leaks.

findings.evidence: _zag_write_file creates or truncates caller-prefix artifacts. Multi-file extraction continues after individual errors and returns nonzero after partial files may be written. Oracle writes its custody frame even when bound matches are insufficient, then runner refuses count!=16.
findings.action: Use an isolated trusted fresh output directory; admit only exit0 plus independently verified receipt/input hashes. Do not expose arbitrary output prefixes or treat partially published files as admission.
findings.admission_effect: Gate always returns91; writes are custody artifacts, never inference results.

positive_evidence: pb_load pins full source and map manifest hashes, validates every page and pm_validate monotonic acyclic edge chains before use.
ts_open and nv_open validate dtype, shape, stride, storage ranges and allocation status for views; successful extraction closes views before map release.
Independent reviewer checks frame bounds, Unicode header lengths, node IDs, edge bounds, terminal links, original bytes and oracle equality separately.
Admission source unconditionally prints actual generated0, parity blocked, CLOSED and returns91 for every normal return; no learn/grant/promotion implementation.
